    }
  }
  return $body
}
function Issue-Lock($issue) {
  # All PC lanes and seats use the same OS temp folder. Hold this only through validation and the claim, not agent work.
  $path = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "voidsworn-runner-issue-$issue.lock"
  if ($test) { $path = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $env:PC_TEST_GH_DB) "issue-$issue.lock" }
  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(30)
  while ($true) {
    try { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None') }
    catch [IO.IOException] {
      if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw 'job claim stayed locked for 30 seconds; no agent started' }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    }
  }
}
function End-Announcement($s) {
  if (-not $s.github -or -not $s.github.claimed) { return }
  try {
    $g = $s.github
    # Never edit or clear a claim replaced by another run, even on the same branch or seat.
    $raw = Invoke-Gh 'GET' "issues/comments/$($g.comment)"
    if (-not $ghOK) { return }
    $comment = ConvertFrom-Json $raw
    if (-not ([string]$comment.body).Contains("- Run: $($s.run)")) { Log 'GitHub finish skipped: status comment belongs to another run'; return }
    $label = 'failed'
    if ($s.status -eq 'checked_push') { $label = 'finished' }
    if ($s.status -eq 'unverified') { $label = 'unverified' }
    if ($s.status -eq 'partial') { $label = 'partial' }
    if ($g.comment) { $null = Invoke-Gh 'PATCH' "issues/comments/$($g.comment)" @{ body = (Status-Body $s $label $code) } }
    # Clearing the owned label must still be attempted when editing the comment fails.
    $null = Invoke-Gh 'DELETE' "issues/$($g.issue)/labels/running"
    if ($ghOK) { $g.claimed = $false; Save-State $s }
  } catch { Log "WARNING: GitHub final status failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
}
try {
  if ($mode -eq 'init') {
    $script:out = $args[1]
    $s = @{ run = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'); branch = $args[2]; status = 'running'; reason = ''; commit = ''; started = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); finished = '' }
    Put (Join-Path $out 'status.json') ($s | ConvertTo-Json)
    # Keep any earlier resume note aside. The current run writes a note only when it has resume context.
    $resumePath = Join-Path $out 'resume.txt'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resumePath) { [IO.File]::Move($resumePath, "$resumePath.$($s.run).previous") }
    # Old run metadata must never turn a later failure into success.
    foreach ($f in @('stop_reason.txt','run_commit.txt','confirmed_commit.txt','partial.txt','checks_node.txt','checks_parity.txt','scratch_path.txt','commit.txt')) { Put (Join-Path $out $f) '' }
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'scratch') {
    $script:out = $args[1]
    $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out 'status.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($s.status -ne 'running' -or $s.scratch) { throw 'scratch directory can only be created once for a running job' }
    $temp = Get-Item -LiteralPath $env:PC_RUN_TEMP -Force
    Assert-PlainDirectory $temp
    $dir = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $temp.FullName "voidsworn-run-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))")
    $token = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
    Put (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchOwnerFile) $token
    $s | Add-Member -NotePropertyName scratch -NotePropertyValue @{
      path = $dir.FullName; token = $token; created = [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks
    }
    Save-State $s
    Put (Join-Path $out 'scratch_path.txt') ($dir.FullName + [Environment]::NewLine)
    Log "run scratch created: $($dir.FullName)"
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'wait') {
    $script:out = $args[1]
    if (-not $env:PC_WAIT_FOR) { exit 0 }
    $p = $env:PC_WAIT_FOR
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Container) { $p = Join-Path $p 'status.json' }
    if ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($p) -eq [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $out 'status.json'))) { throw 'chain stopped: a job cannot wait for itself' }
    $limit = 43200; if ($env:PC_WAIT_SECONDS) { $limit = [int]$env:PC_WAIT_SECONDS }
    $end = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds($limit)
    Log "chain waiting for $p"
    $run = ''
    while ($true) {
      if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { throw 'chain stopped: predecessor status.json is missing; text results cannot prove a checked push' }
      $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
      if (-not $run) { $run = $s.run }
      if (-not $run -or $run -ne $s.run) { throw 'chain stopped: predecessor run changed while waiting' }
      if ($env:PC_WAIT_RUN -and $s.run -ne $env:PC_WAIT_RUN) { throw 'chain stopped: predecessor run id does not match PC_WAIT_RUN' }
      if ($s.status -eq 'checked_push' -and $s.commit -match '^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$') { Log "chain released: checked push $($s.branch) $($s.commit)"; exit 0 }
      if ($s.status -ne 'running') { throw "chain stopped: predecessor ended $($s.status): $($s.reason)" }
      if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $end) { throw 'chain stopped: predecessor did not finish before the wait limit' }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
    }
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'checkout') {
    $repo = $args[1]; $script:out = $args[2]; $br = $args[3]; $sparse = $args[4]
    if ([IO.Path]::GetFileName([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($repo).TrimEnd('\','/')) -ne 'repo') { throw "unexpected checkout path $repo" }
    $source = 'https://github.com/rcbailey12/voidsworn'
    $mirror = Repo-Mirror
    if ($test) {
      if (-not $env:PC_TEST_SOURCE -or -not $env:PC_TEST_MIRROR) { throw 'test checkout requires PC_TEST_SOURCE and PC_TEST_MIRROR (no live network)' }
      $source = $env:PC_TEST_SOURCE
    }
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $mirror
    $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent
    $lock = $null; $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(30); $said = $false
    while (-not $lock) {
      try { $lock = [IO.File]::Open("$mirror.lock", 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None') }
      catch [IO.IOException] {
        if (-not $said) { Log 'waiting for the shared repo copy'; $said = $true }
        if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw 'shared repo copy stayed locked for 30 minutes' }
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
      }
    }
    try {
      if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $mirror 'HEAD'))) {
        Must-Git @('init','--bare',$mirror)
        Must-Git @('--git-dir',$mirror,'remote','add','--mirror=fetch','origin',$source)
      }
      $url = @(Git @('--git-dir',$mirror,'remote','get-url','origin'))
      if ($gitExit -ne 0 -or $url[0] -ne $source) { throw 'shared repo copy has an unexpected origin; kept unchanged' }
      Retry-Git 'mirror fetch' @('--git-dir',$mirror,'-c','http.lowSpeedLimit=1000','-c','http.lowSpeedTime=60','fetch','--prune','origin')
      # The remote default branch may not yet be set by init --bare.
      Must-Git @('--git-dir',$mirror,'symbolic-ref','HEAD','refs/heads/main')
      $reuse = Can-ReuseRepo $repo $mirror $sparse
      if ($reuse) {
        Retry-Git 'checkout fetch' @('-C',$repo,'fetch','--no-tags',$mirror,'+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*')
      }
    } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
    # A pinned lane must not hold the shared mirror lock for the ten-minute preservation wait.
    if (-not $reuse) { Keep-Repo $repo 'kept' }
    Warn-KeptRepos $repo
    $delay = 120; if ($test -and $env:PC_TEST_RETRY_SECONDS) { $delay = [int]$env:PC_TEST_RETRY_SECONDS }
    for ($attempt = 1; -not $reuse -and $attempt -le 3; $attempt++) {
        Log "local clone attempt $attempt/3"
        # Reacquire around each local clone: mirror fetch and hardlink cloning must still serialize.
        $lock = $null
        while (-not $lock) {
          try { $lock = [IO.File]::Open("$mirror.lock", 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None') }
          catch [IO.IOException] {
            if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw 'shared repo copy stayed locked for 30 minutes' }
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
          }
        }
        try { $null = Git @('clone','-q','-c','core.autocrlf=false','--local','--no-checkout',$mirror,$repo) }
        finally { $lock.Dispose() }
        if ($gitExit -eq 0) { break }
        Keep-Repo $repo 'clone-failed'
        if ($attempt -eq 3) { throw 'local clone failed after 3 attempts; see git_log.txt' }
        Log "local clone failed; retry in $delay seconds"; Start-Sleep -Seconds $delay
    }
    # Local hardlinks share immutable objects without alternates. All pushes go to GitHub, never to the mirror.
    Must-Git @('-C',$repo,'remote','set-url','origin',$source)
    if ($sparse) { Must-Git (@('-C',$repo,'sparse-checkout','set','--no-cone') + @($sparse -split '\s+')) }
    $null = Git @('-C',$repo,'checkout','--no-overwrite-ignore','-q','-B',$br,'refs/remotes/origin/main')
    $switchExit = $gitExit
    if ($reuse) {
      # A writer may have changed the checkout after eligibility. Stop without discarding its bytes.
      try { $null = Reuse-Caches $repo }
      catch { throw "checkout changed while starting; kept as is: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    }
    if ($switchExit -ne 0) { throw "git checkout failed (exit $switchExit); see git_log.txt" }
    if ($reuse) { Log 'earlier checkout reused in place; ignored files left in place' }
    $base = @(Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse','HEAD'))[0]
    Put (Join-Path $out 'base_commit.txt') $base
    $partial = "refs/remotes/origin/$br-partial"
    $tip = @(Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse','--verify','--quiet',$partial))
    if ($gitExit -eq 0) {
      $null = Git @('-C',$repo,'merge-base','--is-ancestor',$tip[0],'HEAD')
      if ($gitExit -eq 0) {
        Log "skipping $br-partial at $($tip[0]): already in HEAD"
        exit 0
      }
      Log "resuming $br-partial at $($tip[0])"
      # Full mirror history makes the merge base available. A conflict stays on disk and stops before the model.
      $null = Git @('-C',$repo,'merge','--no-edit',$partial)
      if ($gitExit -ne 0) { throw "resume merge failed for $br-partial; checkout and conflict kept; no agent started" }
      $resume = "Resumed by merging $br-partial ($($tip[0])). Inspect and finish this work; do not restart it from main."
      $message = (Git @('-C',$repo,'log','-1','--format=%B',$partial)) -join "`n"
      $note = [regex]::Match($message, '(?ms)^## Runner resume note \(issue 818\)\r?\n.*?^## End runner resume note')
      if ($note.Success) { $resume += "`n`n" + $note.Value }
      Put (Join-Path $out 'resume.txt') $resume
    }
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'base') {
    $repo = $args[1]; $script:out = $args[2]
    $body = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($args[3])
    $lines = @(Find-BaseLines $body)
    if ($lines.Count -eq 0) { exit 0 }
    if ($lines.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Base merge stopped: use one Base: <branch> line; no agent started' }
    $base = $lines[0].Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    $null = Git @('check-ref-format',"refs/heads/$base")
    if (-not $base -or $gitExit -ne 0) { throw "Base merge stopped: invalid branch '$base'; no agent started" }
    Log "Base: fetching and merging origin/$base before the agent"
    Retry-Git 'Base fetch' @('-C',$repo,'fetch','--no-tags','origin',"+refs/heads/${base}:refs/remotes/origin/$base")
    $tip = @(Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse',"refs/remotes/origin/$base"))[0]
    # --no-ff makes the runner commit a real merge even when a fast-forward is possible. No editor or signing prompt.
    $null = Git @('-C',$repo,'-c','commit.gpgsign=false','merge','--no-ff','--no-edit','--no-gpg-sign','-m',"Runner Base: origin/$base", "refs/remotes/origin/$base")
    if ($gitExit -ne 0) { throw "Base merge failed for origin/$base; checkout and conflict kept; no agent started (see git_log.txt)" }
    $note = "Base already merged by the runner: origin/$base ($tip). The merge is committed; do not merge it yourself."
    $resume = Read (Join-Path $out 'resume.txt')
    Put (Join-Path $out 'resume.txt') ("$resume`n$note".Trim())
    Log $note
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'board-dryrun') {
    $script:out = $args[1]
    $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out
    $script:boardReadOnly = $true
    if ($test -and (-not $env:PC_TEST_GH -or -not $env:PC_TEST_GH_DB)) { throw 'test board audit requires fake gh and PC_TEST_GH_DB' }
    $issues = @(Gh-Pages 'issues?state=open&per_page=100')
    $pulls = @(Gh-Pages 'pulls?state=open&per_page=100')
    $branches = @(Gh-Pages 'branches?per_page=100')
    $report = @("Board dry run (UTC): $([DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')); no claims or agent calls")
    foreach ($i in ($issues | Sort-Object number)) {
      if ($i.pull_request -or $i.state -ne 'open') { continue }
      $seats = @($i.labels | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -is [string]) { $_ } else { $_.name } } | Where-Object { $_ -in @('codex','muse','opus') })
      foreach ($prefix in $seats) {
        try {
          $null = Validate-Job $i ([string]$i.number) $prefix $pulls $branches
          $report += "#$($i.number) [$prefix] ACCEPT"
        } catch { $report += "#$($i.number) [$prefix] REFUSE: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
      }
    }
    Put (Join-Path $out 'board_audit.txt') (($report -join "`n") + "`n")
    $report | ForEach-Object { Log $_ }
    exit 0
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'announce') {
    $script:out = $args[1]
    $issue = $args[2]
    if ($issue -notmatch '^[1-9][0-9]*$') { throw 'invalid job issue number; no agent started' }
    if ($test -and (-not $env:PC_TEST_GH -or -not $env:PC_TEST_GH_DB)) { throw 'test claim requires fake gh and PC_TEST_GH_DB (no live GitHub); no agent started' }
    $lock = Issue-Lock $issue
    try {
      $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out 'status.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
      $repo = $args[4]
      $i = Require-Gh 'GET' "issues/$issue"
      if ($i.state -ne 'open' -or $i.pull_request) { throw "job refused: issue #$issue is not an open job (state: $($i.state)); no agent started" }
      if (@($i.labels | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'running' -or $_ -eq 'running' }).Count) { throw "job refused: issue #$issue already carries running; another run owns the claim; no agent started" }
      $launchBranch = $args[8]
      if (-not $launchBranch) { $launchBranch = $s.branch }
      $pulls = @(Gh-Pages 'pulls?state=open&per_page=100')
      $branches = @(Gh-Pages 'branches?per_page=100')
      $body = Validate-Job $i $issue $args[3] $pulls $branches $launchBranch
      $comments = @(Gh-Pages "issues/$issue/comments?per_page=100")
      # Snapshot exactly what was validated. Prep must never re-fetch a possibly changed or older brief.
      Put (Join-Path $out 'validated_issue.json') (@{ number = $issue; title = $i.title; body = $body; run = $s.run } | ConvertTo-Json)
      $s | Add-Member -NotePropertyName instruction_run -NotePropertyValue $s.run -Force
      Save-State $s
      # Dry runs validate read-only. Only fixture tests may write to their fake GitHub.
      if ($args[7] -ne 'real' -and -not $test) { Log "job validated: issue #$issue (dry run, no claim written)"; exit 0 }
      $head = @($branches | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'main' } | ForEach-Object { $_.commit.sha }) -join ''
      # Issue 947: the public status comment names the lane, never the machine or a PC path (folder stays in local state only).
      $lane = switch ((Split-Path -Leaf (Split-Path -Parent $repo)).ToLowerInvariant()) { 'board' { 'main' } 'board_b' { 'B' } 'board_c' { 'C' } 'board_d' { 'D' } default { 'other' } }
      $g = @{ issue = $issue; seat = $args[3]; folder = $repo; lane = $lane;
        started = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); ceiling = $args[5]; resume = $args[6]; comment = 0;
        start_commit = $head; claimed = $false; marker = "<!-- voidsworn-runner-status branch=$($s.branch) -->" }
      $s | Add-Member -NotePropertyName github -NotePropertyValue $g -Force
      Save-State $s
      $null = Invoke-Gh 'GET' 'labels/running'
      if (-not $ghOK) { $null = Require-Gh 'POST' 'labels' @{ name = 'running'; color = '1D76DB'; description = 'An agent is working this issue' } }
      $null = Require-Gh 'POST' "issues/$issue/labels" @{ labels = @('running') }
      $g.claimed = $true
      # Reuse this branch's comment on retries instead of adding a new comment every run.
      try {
        foreach ($comment in $comments) { if (([string]$comment.body).StartsWith($g.marker)) { $g.comment = $comment.id } }
        $payload = @{ body = (Status-Body $s 'running' '') }
        if ($g.comment) { $null = Require-Gh 'PATCH' "issues/comments/$($g.comment)" $payload }
        else { $reply = Require-Gh 'POST' "issues/$issue/comments" $payload; $g.comment = $reply.id }
        if (-not $g.comment) { throw 'claim comment has no id; no agent started' }
        $claimedIssue = Require-Gh 'GET' "issues/$issue"
        $claimedComment = Require-Gh 'GET' "issues/comments/$($g.comment)"
        if (-not @($claimedIssue.labels | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'running' -or $_ -eq 'running' }).Count -or
          -not ([string]$claimedComment.body).StartsWith($g.marker) -or -not ([string]$claimedComment.body).Contains("- Run: $($s.run)")) {
          throw 'claim did not land: running label and owned status comment must read back; no agent started'
        }
        Save-State $s
      } catch {
        # Still under the issue lock: no other local seat can have acquired this label in between.
        $null = Invoke-Gh 'DELETE' "issues/$issue/labels/running"
        $g.claimed = $false; Save-State $s
        throw
      }
      Log "job claimed: issue #$issue by $($g.seat), run $($s.run); current instruction validated"
    } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
    exit 0
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'fetch') {
    $repo = $args[1]; $script:out = $args[2]
    Retry-Git 'branch fetch' @('-C',$repo,'fetch','-q','origin',$args[3])
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'preflight') {
    $script:out = $args[1]; $repo = $args[2]; $kind = $args[3]; $exe = $args[4]; $model = $args[5]; $variant = $args[6]
    $probe = Join-Path $out 'preflight'; $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $probe
    $prompt = 'Reply with exactly RUNNER_READY. Do not use tools or read any files.'
    switch ($kind) {
      'opencode' { $words = @('run','--auto','--format','json','-m',$model,'--dir',$probe); if ($variant) { $words += @('--variant',($variant -replace '^--variant\s+','')) }; $words += $prompt }
      'kimi' { $words = @('-m',$model,'--output-format','text','-p',$prompt) }
      'codex' { $words = @('exec','-m',$model,'-c','model_reasoning_effort=low','--ephemeral','--skip-git-repo-check','--color','never','-C',$probe,'-o',(Join-Path $probe 'reply.txt'),$prompt) }
      default { throw "unknown preflight harness $kind" }
    }
    if ($test -and $env:PC_TEST_PREFLIGHT) { $exe = $env:PC_TEST_PREFLIGHT }
    Log "preflight: $kind $model"
    $psi = New-Object Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
    $psi.FileName = $exe; $psi.Arguments = ($words | ForEach-Object { Quote $_ }) -join ' '
    if ($exe -match '\.(cmd|bat)$') { $psi.FileName = $env:COMSPEC; $psi.Arguments = '/d /s /c ""' + $exe + '" ' + $psi.Arguments + '"' }
    $psi.WorkingDirectory = $probe; $psi.UseShellExecute = $false; $psi.CreateNoWindow = $true
    $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true
    # The probe must use the same verified kill as an agent, including when taskkill cannot enumerate its tree.
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'run_timeout.ps1') -LibraryOnly
    Initialize-RunTree
    $p = New-Object Diagnostics.Process; $p.StartInfo = $psi
    $null = $p.Start(); $stdout = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(); $stderr = $p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
    $null = $p.Handle
    $tree = @{}; $tree[$p.Id] = $p
    try {
    $cap = 90; if ($test -and $env:PC_TEST_PREFLIGHT_SECONDS) { $cap = [int]$env:PC_TEST_PREFLIGHT_SECONDS }
    if (-not $p.WaitForExit($cap * 1000)) {
      Stop-RunTree $p $tree (Join-Path $out 'preflight_kill_log.txt')
      Put (Join-Path $out 'preflight_log.txt') ($stdout.Result + "`n" + $stderr.Result)
      throw "preflight failed: $kind timed out after $cap seconds"
    }
    $p.WaitForExit(); $code = $p.ExitCode
    } finally {
      Update-RunTree $tree
      if (@($tree.Values | Where-Object { -not $_.HasExited }).Count) { Stop-RunTree $p $tree (Join-Path $out 'preflight_kill_log.txt') }
      foreach ($child in $tree.Values) { $child.Dispose() }
    }
    $raw = $stdout.Result + "`n" + $stderr.Result
    Put (Join-Path $out 'preflight_log.txt') $raw
    $reply = Read (Join-Path $probe 'reply.txt')
    if ($kind -eq 'kimi') {
      # Kimi Code prints its thinking and its answer as bullet lines, then a 'To resume this session' line (first live run,
      # Nov 15): the reply is the answer line, bullet stripped.
      $reply = ''
      foreach ($line in ($stdout.Result -split '\r?\n')) { $t = ($line -replace '^[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','').Trim(); if ($t -eq 'RUNNER_READY') { $reply = $t } }
    }
    if ($kind -eq 'opencode') {
      $reply = ''
      foreach ($line in ($stdout.Result -split '\r?\n')) {
        try { $ev = $line | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($ev.type -eq 'text') { $reply += [string]$ev.part.text } } catch { }
      }
    }
    $problem = @($raw -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { $_ -match '(?i)"type"\s*:\s*"error"|"is_error"\s*:\s*true|credit balance|no credential|not logged|unauthori[sz]ed|quota|rate.limit|expired|error:|"error"\s*:' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
    if ($code -ne 0 -or $problem.Count -or $reply.Trim() -ne 'RUNNER_READY') {
      $why = if ($problem.Count) { $problem[0] } else { @($raw -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -Last 1) -join '' }
      $why = ($why -replace '\s+',' ').Trim(); if ($why.Length -gt 350) { $why = $why.Substring(0,350) }
      throw "preflight failed: $kind exit $code; $why (see preflight_log.txt)"
    }
    Log "preflight passed: $kind $model"
  }
  elseif ($mode -eq 'space') {
    # Issue 722 (audit 706 finding 7): never start a run the disk cannot hold. Runs before the chain wait, so a
    # low disk also fails a chained child closed instead of burning a wait.
    $script:out = $args[1]; $setf = $args[2]; $target = $args[3]
    if ($test -and $env:PC_TEST_SETTINGS) { $setf = $env:PC_TEST_SETTINGS }
    $floor = 60
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setf) {
      foreach ($l in [IO.File]::ReadAllLines($setf)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match($l, '^\s*min_free_gb\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*$')
        if ($m.Success) { $floor = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value }
      }
    }
    $root = [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($target)).TrimEnd('\')
    $free = (New-Object IO.DriveInfo($root)).AvailableFreeSpace
    if ($test -and $env:PC_TEST_SPACE_FREE_MB) { $free = [int64]$env:PC_TEST_SPACE_FREE_MB * 1MB }
    $freeGB = [math]::Round($free / 1GB, 1)
    if ($free -lt ($floor * 1GB)) {
      $why = "refusing to start: drive $root has $freeGB GB free, below the min_free_gb=$floor floor"
      Log $why
      State 'failed' $why
      exit 14
    }

# Prepare one job-board issue for Codex (called by codex_issue.bat). PowerShell 5.1.
# Usage: codex_issue.ps1 run  <n> <repo folder>                holds the checkout lock around the batch run
# Usage: codex_issue.ps1 prep <n> <repo folder> <out folder>   writes CODEX_TASK.md, effort.txt, title.txt
#        codex_issue.ps1 msg  <n> <repo folder> <out folder>   writes commit.txt from title.txt and Codex's last message
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
$mode = $args[0]; $n = $args[1]; $repo = $args[2]; $out = $args[3]
if ($mode -eq 'run') {
  if ($n -notmatch '^[1-9][0-9]*$') { Write-Host 'invalid job issue number; no agent started'; exit 14 }
  $lock = $null
  try {
    $repo = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($repo)
    $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($repo))
    # Keep this file beside the checkout so moving or cloning repo cannot change the lock.
    # lane_tools_refresh.ps1 opens the same file, also without sharing.
    $lock = [IO.File]::Open("$repo.checkout.lock", 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
    $runner = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'codex_issue.bat'
    $start = New-Object Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
    $start.FileName = $env:COMSPEC
    $start.Arguments = '/d /s /c ""' + $runner + '" ' + $n + ' locked"'
    $start.UseShellExecute = $false
    $start.EnvironmentVariables['CODEX_LOCKED_REPO'] = $args[2]
    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
    try { $child.WaitForExit(); exit $child.ExitCode }
    finally { $child.Dispose() }
  } catch {
    if (-not $lock) { Write-Host "job refused: cannot take the Codex checkout lock (lane busy or lock unavailable); no agent started" }
    else { Write-Host "job stopped: could not run codex_issue.bat ($($_.Exception.Message))" }
    exit 14
  } finally {
    if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() }
  }
}
$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
# Issue 953: the intentional agent report can carry PC paths. A path to a file inside this job's checkout becomes a
# GitHub link on the delivery branch, so it opens on a phone; every other path under the user's home folder becomes
# %USERPROFILE%\..., so no PC folder name reaches a public pull request. Everything else is left exactly as written.
function Path-Pattern([string]$p) {
  if (-not $p) { return '' }
  # Either separator matches, whatever the host wrote: every joined separator is [\\/]+, and a leading
  # separator (a Unix absolute path) is part of the match so none is left in front of the replacement.
  $lead = ''
  if ($p -match '^[\\/]') { $lead = '[\\/]+' }
  $segs = @($p -split '[\\/]+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
  if (-not $segs.Count) { return '' }
  return $lead + (@($segs | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }) -join '[\\/]+')
}
function Profile-Root {
  if ($env:USERPROFILE) { return $env:USERPROFILE }
  if ($env:HOME) { return $env:HOME }
  return ''
}

# Automatic checks on every agent branch (Ryan, Nov 2 2026, FINDINGS R75). One run per push since issue 359.
# Every push to a codex/, muse/, work/ or opus/ branch gets a pass or fail mark on its head commit, and the pull request
# of that branch shows it, before the Board reviews it.
# Why this starts on "push" and not on "pull_request" (Nov 10 2026): auto_pr.yml opens the pull request with GitHub's own
# token, and GitHub holds every pull_request run of a bot-opened pull request until a person approves it. Nobody did, so
# that run never started a job, and when the pull request was merged it turned into a failed run with no jobs: one
# failure email per pull request. auto_pr.yml started a second run by hand to get round that, so every later push ran
# all the checks twice. A push made with a person's token (the PC, Muse, a Claude thread) starts this workflow once.
# A branch with any other name gets no automatic run: open its pull request by hand and start the checks by hand
# (Actions tab, "checks", "Run workflow", pick the branch; or: gh workflow run checks.yml --ref <branch>).
# Each job merges main into its checkout first, so it tests what would land, as the old pull_request runs did.
name: checks
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'codex/**'
      - 'muse/**'
      - 'work/**'
      - 'opus/**'
      # A run the PC runner marks partial pushes to <branch>-partial: a mid-work snapshot that fails by nature and opens no
      # pull request, so it gets no checks (each failure mailed Ryan; Nov 15, "I keep seeing GitHub errors"). The resumed
      # run's own branch is checked when it lands.
      - '!codex/**-partial'
      - '!work/**-partial'
      - '!opus/**-partial'
  workflow_dispatch:
concurrency:
  group: checks-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  standing-checks:
    name: Standing checks (rules, text, saves)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      # Test what would land: main merged into the branch. If they conflict, the checks run on the branch alone and say so
      # (GitHub will not merge a conflicting pull request anyway; merging main into the branch and pushing runs them again).
      - name: Merge main in (test the branch as it would land)
        if: github.ref != 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          git config user.name "checks"; git config user.email "checks@users.noreply.github.com"
          if git merge -q --no-edit origin/main; then
            echo "Testing ${GITHUB_SHA::7} merged with main $(git rev-parse --short origin/main)."
          else
            git merge --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "::warning::main could not be merged into this branch (a conflict), so these checks ran on the branch alone. Merge main into the branch and push again."
          fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Picture provenance self-test dependency
        run: python -m pip install Pillow
      - name: No em dashes in changed text files (house rule)
        run: node contrib/opus/tools/check_em_dashes.js
      - name: Run all standing checks
        run: node contrib/opus/tools/run_all_checks.js

function Update-PauseJobs($Root, $Jobs, $Leftovers) {
  foreach ($j in Get-PauseJobs $Root) {
    if ($j.Leftover -and -not $Jobs.ContainsKey($j.Out)) { $Leftovers[$j.Out] = $j }
    else {
      # Once seen live during this pause, await its runner even if its checks later go quiet.
      if (-not $Jobs.ContainsKey($j.Out)) { $Jobs[$j.Out] = $j }
      $Leftovers.Remove($j.Out)
    }
  }
}
function Invoke-PauseGit($Ref, $Deadline, $Executable = 'git.exe') {
  # Bound the verification by the same pause deadline. No prompt, no gh, no checkout or origin assumptions.
  $ms = [int][math]::Min(30000, [math]::Max(0, ($Deadline - (Get-Date)).TotalMilliseconds))
  if ($ms -le 0) { throw 'time limit reached before GitHub verification' }
  $info = New-Object Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
  $info.FileName = $Executable
  $info.Arguments = 'ls-remote --exit-code https://github.com/rcbailey12/voidsworn.git ' + $Ref
  $info.UseShellExecute = $false; $info.CreateNoWindow = $true
  $info.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $info.RedirectStandardError = $true
  $info.EnvironmentVariables['GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT'] = '0'
  $info.EnvironmentVariables['GCM_INTERACTIVE'] = 'Never'
  $p = New-Object Diagnostics.Process
  $p.StartInfo = $info
  try {
    $null = $p.Start()
    $stdout = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(); $stderr = $p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
    if (-not $p.WaitForExit($ms)) { throw 'git ls-remote timed out; checkpoint unverified' }
    if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "git ls-remote failed (exit $($p.ExitCode))" }
    return $stdout.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
  } finally {
    # Never kill another process, including on a verification timeout.
    $p.Dispose()
  }
}
function Test-PauseJob($Job, $Deadline) {
  $word = 'unresolved'; $reason = ''; $ref = ''; $commit = ''
  try {
    $s = Read-PauseState (Join-Path $Job.Out 'status.json')
    if (-not $s) { throw 'status.json missing or unreadable' }
    if ($Job.State -and $Job.State.run -ne $s.run) { throw 'runner changed during pause' }
    if ($s.status -eq 'running') { throw 'runner still running (checks or push unfinished; time limit reached)' }
    if ($s.status -notin @('checked_push','partial')) { throw "runner status $($s.status) is unverified" }
    if ($s.branch -notmatch '^(codex|work|muse|opus)/issue-\d+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$') { throw 'invalid delivery branch' }
    $commit = Read-PauseText (Join-Path $Job.Out 'run_commit.txt')
    $confirmed = Read-PauseText (Join-Path $Job.Out 'confirmed_commit.txt')
    if ($commit -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$' -or $confirmed -ne $commit -or $s.commit -ne $commit) {
      throw 'run_commit.txt, confirmed_commit.txt and status commit do not agree'
    }
    $ref = "refs/heads/$($s.branch)"
    if ($s.status -eq 'partial') { $ref += '-partial' }
    $remote = Invoke-PauseGit $ref $Deadline
    if ($remote.Trim() -notmatch ('^' + [regex]::Escape($commit) + '\s+' + [regex]::Escape($ref) + '$')) {
      throw 'GitHub branch does not hold the confirmed commit'
    }
    # A rerun must not replace the metadata while the network check is in flight.
    $after = Read-PauseState (Join-Path $Job.Out 'status.json')
    if (-not $after -or $after.run -ne $s.run -or $after.status -ne $s.status -or $after.commit -ne $commit) {
      throw 'runner changed during GitHub verification'
    }
    $word = if ($s.status -eq 'checked_push') { 'done' } else { 'checkpoint verified' }
    $reason = "$ref $commit"
  } catch { $reason = $_.Exception.Message }
  return [pscustomobject]@{ Word = $word; Reason = $reason; State = $s; Commit = $commit }
}

# Issue 953: the report and the runner check logs carry PC paths. A path to a file inside this job's checkout becomes a
# GitHub link on the delivery branch, so it opens on a phone; every other path under the user's home folder becomes
# %USERPROFILE%\..., so no PC folder name reaches a public pull request. Everything else is left exactly as written.
function Path-Pattern([string]$p) {
  if (-not $p) { return '' }
  # Either separator matches, whatever the host wrote: every joined separator is [\\/]+, and a leading
  # separator (a Unix absolute path) is part of the match so none is left in front of the replacement.
  $lead = ''
  if ($p -match '^[\\/]') { $lead = '[\\/]+' }
  $segs = @($p -split '[\\/]+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
  if (-not $segs.Count) { return '' }
  return $lead + (@($segs | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }) -join '[\\/]+')
}
function Profile-Root {
  if ($env:USERPROFILE) { return $env:USERPROFILE }
  if ($env:HOME) { return $env:HOME }
  return ''
}

# Pause every Board job on Ryan's PC without losing or deleting anything (Ryan, Nov 15 2026: "I don't want to cause anything
# to get lost or deleted with the pauses as well, so let's bake that in"; RULEBOOK 3.x, the pause rule).
#
# How: (1) withdraw the GPU go; (2) close only the chain windows still WAITING (no job inside them yet, so nothing to save);
# (3) end the AI processes (codex, opencode). A runner whose agent ends commits the work so far and pushes it to the issue's
# -partial branch (codex_issue.bat and work_issue.bat, issue 377), so the work survives in GitHub and the next run resumes it.
# A queued job that starts after this sees its agent ended at the preflight and stops before touching anything. Job windows that
# are mid-run are never closed (closing one would stop its runner before the push). Nothing is ever deleted.
# (4) wait for runner status, then verify each confirmed commit on GitHub before declaring a restart safe.
# Usage: powershell -File pause_all.ps1 [-At HH:mm] [-Minutes 60]
param([string]$At = "", [int]$Minutes = 60)

function Read-PauseText($Path) {
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf) { return [IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path).Trim() }
  return ''
}
function Read-PauseState($Path) {
  try {
    $s = Read-PauseText $Path | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
    if (-not $s.status -or -not $s.run -or -not $s.branch) { return $null }
    return $s
  } catch { return $null }
}
function Get-PauseJobs($Root) {
  $processes = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop)
  $recent = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddMinutes(-30)
  # Only job metadata, never a recursive walk through repos, caches or old Codex runs/backups.
  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
    $base = Join-Path $Root $lane
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
    $jobs = @(
      foreach ($dir in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $base -Directory -ErrorAction Stop) {
        if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
          if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^issue-\d+-[a-z0-9]+$') { continue }
          $outs = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Directory -ErrorAction Stop |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' } |
            ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'out' })
        } else {
          if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^issue-\d+$') { continue }
          $outs = @($dir.FullName)
        }
        foreach ($out in $outs) {
          $s = Read-PauseState (Join-Path $out 'status.json')
          $stamp = [datetime]::MinValue
          if (-not $s -or -not [datetime]::TryParse([string]$s.started, [ref]$stamp)) {
            $f = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out 'result.txt') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            $stamp = if ($f) { $f.LastWriteTimeUtc } else { $dir.LastWriteTimeUtc }
          } else { $stamp = $stamp.ToUniversalTime() }
          $activity = [datetime]::MinValue
          foreach ($name in @('status.json','log.txt','result.txt','checks_node.txt','checks_parity.txt')) {
            $file = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out $name) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if ($file -and $file.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $activity) { $activity = $file.LastWriteTimeUtc }
          }
          # DeepSeek keeps out and repo beside each other under its timestamped run folder.
          $folder = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Split-Path -Parent $out } else { $out }
          $pattern = [regex]::Escape($folder.Replace('/','\')) + '(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'
          $hasProcess = @($processes | Where-Object { ([string]$_.CommandLine).Replace('/','\') -match $pattern }).Count -gt 0
          [pscustomobject]@{
            Lane = $lane; Job = $dir.Name; Out = $out; State = $s; Stamp = $stamp
            Activity = $activity; HasProcess = $hasProcess; Leftover = $false
          }
        }
      }
    )
    # Newest means last activity, not start time: a stopped run may have started after a still-live job.
    $latest = $jobs | Sort-Object Activity, Stamp -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
      try {
        $s = Read-PauseState (Join-Path $j.Out 'status.json')
        $changed = -not $s -or $s.run -ne $result.State.run -or $s.status -ne $result.State.status -or
          $s.branch -ne $result.State.branch -or $s.commit -ne $result.Commit -or
          (Read-PauseText (Join-Path $j.Out 'run_commit.txt')) -ne $result.Commit -or
          (Read-PauseText (Join-Path $j.Out 'confirmed_commit.txt')) -ne $result.Commit
      } catch { $changed = $true }
      if ($changed) {
        $result.Word = 'unresolved'; $result.Reason = 'runner changed before final report'
      }
    }
    $name = "$lane/$($j.Job)"
    Log ("{0}: {1} ({2}); {3}" -f $name, $result.Word, $result.Reason, $j.Out)
    if ($result.Word -eq 'unresolved') { $unresolved += $name }
  }
}
if (-not $settled -or $scanError -or (Get-Date) -ge $end) {
  $why = if ($scanError) { $scanError } else { 'time limit reached before agents and runners settled' }
  Log "pause: unresolved ($why)"; $unresolved += 'pause'
}
if ($unresolved.Count) { Log ("NOT safe to restart: " + ($unresolved -join ', ')) }
else { Log 'safe to restart' }
}

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  $mode = if ($existingOnly) { 'Open' } else { 'OpenOrCreate' }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, $mode, 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}

function Write-Step([string]$Message) {
  $line = '{0:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ} {1} {2}' -f [DateTime]::UtcNow, $Build, $Message
  [IO.File]::AppendAllText($logPath, $line + [Environment]::NewLine)
  Write-Host $line
}

function Assert-IdleLane {
  $seatRoot = Join-Path $root $seat
  $statusFiles = foreach ($issue in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $seatRoot -Directory -Filter 'issue-*') {
    if ($seat -eq 'work217') {
      if ($issue.Name -notmatch '^issue-\d+-[a-z0-9]+$') { continue }
      foreach ($run in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $issue.FullName -Directory) {
        if ($run.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out\status.json' }
      }
    } elseif ($issue.Name -match '^issue-\d+$') {
      Join-Path $issue.FullName 'status.json'
    }
  }
  foreach ($file in $statusFiles) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) { continue }
    try {
      $state = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($file) | ConvertFrom-Json
      if (-not $state.status) { throw 'missing status' }
    } catch {
      throw "refused: cannot verify runner status at $file"
    }
    if ($state.status -eq 'running') { throw "refused: job still running at $file" }
  }
}

function Invoke-SourceGit([string]$Step, [string[]]$Arguments) {
  # The only remote is public. Suppress native output and prevent credential helpers and prompts.
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
  $output = & git.exe -c credential.helper= -c core.autocrlf=false -c http.sslBackend=openssl -c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0 @Arguments 2>$null
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "$Step failed (git exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
  return $output
}

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  $mode = if ($existingOnly) { 'Open' } else { 'OpenOrCreate' }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, $mode, 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }

+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {

+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"

+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
+        }
+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+    }
+  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {

+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  $mode = if ($existingOnly) { 'Open' } else { 'OpenOrCreate' }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, $mode, 'ReadWrite', 'None')
 }
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
+          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
+        }
+        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
+        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
+        }
+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+    }
+  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }
+}

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try { $child.WaitForExit(); return $child.ExitCode }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
+}

+# R336 PC cleanup. PowerShell 5.1. The Board reads --dry-run before the first live run.
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'runner_common.ps1') cleanup-library
+
+function Log($line) {
+  $script:log.WriteLine($line)
+  Write-Host $line
+}
+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Test-RecentAutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $false
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { throw "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    if ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { throw "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    if ($owned) {
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}
+
+$trigger = $args[0]
+if ($args.Count -gt 1 -or $trigger -notin @($null,'--dry-run','--nightly','--low-space')) {
+  Write-Host 'usage: janitor.bat [--dry-run | --nightly | --low-space]'
+  exit 2
+}
+$dryRun = $trigger -eq '--dry-run'
+$automatic = $trigger -in @('--nightly','--low-space')
+$root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads/voidsworn_test'
+$temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Runner-Temp)).TrimEnd('\','/')
+$now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+$lock = $null; $script:log = $null
+try {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force)
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force)
+  $night = ''
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') {
+    $central = [TimeZoneInfo]::ConvertTimeBySystemTimeZoneId($now, 'Central Standard Time')
+    if ($central.Hour -lt 3) { exit 0 }
+    $night = $central.ToString('yyyyMMdd')
+  }
+  if (-not $dryRun) {
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { Write-Host 'janitor skipped during the PC pause'; exit 0 }
+    try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $root 'janitor.lock') }
+    catch { Write-Host "janitor lock in use or unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 0 }
+    if ($automatic -and (Test-RecentAutomaticRun $lock $trigger $now $night)) { exit 0 }
+  }
+  $drive = New-Object IO.DriveInfo([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($root))
+  $logPath = Join-Path $root "janitor_$((Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmm')).txt"
+  $logItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $logPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($logItem -and ($logItem -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($logItem.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw 'janitor log is not a plain file'
+  }
+  $script:log = New-Object IO.StreamWriter($logPath, $true, $utf8)
+  $script:log.AutoFlush = $true
+  $mode = if ($dryRun) { 'dry run' } elseif ($automatic) { $trigger } else { 'manual' }
+  Log "janitor $mode at $($now.ToString('o'))"
+  Log "free space before: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+  $mirror = Repo-Mirror
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d')) {
+    $board = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $board -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    try { Remove-OlderKeptRepos $board $mirror $dryRun }
+    catch { Log "kept lane $board (scan unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  }
+  $legacy = @{}
+  foreach ($run in Get-LegacyRuns $root) { $legacy[[string]$run.State.scratch.path] = $run.Issue }
+  # Check old runners once, and take each current issue lock again immediately before making its decision.
+  $activeLegacy = @(Get-ActiveLegacyIssues @(Get-LegacyRuns $root))
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force).EnumerateDirectories()) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^(voidsworn|issue|tune2-)') { continue }
+    $owned = $dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-run-*'
+    $issue = ''
+    if ($owned -and $dir.Name -match '^voidsworn-run-([1-9][0-9]*)-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    elseif ($owned) { $issue = $legacy[$dir.FullName] }
+    elseif ($dir.Name -match '^(?:issue|voidsworn(?:[-_](?:issue|parity))?|tune2)[-_]*([1-9][0-9]*)(?=[-_.]|$)') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    $why = if ($owned) { 'runner scratch' } elseif ($dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-parity-*') { 'parity scratch' } else { 'job scratch' }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $issue $why 3 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $owned
+  }
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force).EnumerateDirectories('opus*')) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^opus([1-9][0-9]*)(?:out.*)?$') { continue }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $Matches[1] 'helper folder' 24 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $false
+  }
+} catch {
+  if ($script:log) { Log "janitor stopped: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  else { Write-Host "janitor could not start: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  exit 1
+} finally {
+  if ($script:log) {
+    Log "free space after: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+    Log 'all done'
+    $script:log.Dispose()
+  }
+  if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() }
+}
+exit 0

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token
+}
+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {
+  $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:PC_RUN_TEMP).TrimEnd('\','/')
+  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($record.path)
+  if ($full -ne $record.path -or $full -ne $expected -or (Split-Path -Parent $full) -ne $temp -or
+      (Split-Path -Leaf $full) -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
+    throw 'recorded path does not match this run and its TEMP directory'
+  }
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { return }
+  $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $full -Force
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
+  if ((Read-ScratchOwner $full) -cne $record.token) { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  # Linux filesystems do not always expose a stable directory birth time.
+  if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT -and
+      [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks -ne $record.created) { throw 'recorded directory was replaced' }
+  return $dir
+}
+function Remove-CleanupDirectory($dir) {

+  if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop
+  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir.FullName) { throw 'directory could not be fully removed' }
+}

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  $mode = if ($existingOnly) { 'Open' } else { 'OpenOrCreate' }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, $mode, 'ReadWrite', 'None')
 }
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"

+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Test-RecentAutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $false
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { throw "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    if ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { throw "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    if ($owned) {
+      if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') { throw 'runner scratch name could not be verified' }
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}
+
+$trigger = $args[0]
+if ($args.Count -gt 1 -or $trigger -notin @($null,'--dry-run','--nightly','--low-space')) {
+  Write-Host 'usage: janitor.bat [--dry-run | --nightly | --low-space]'
+  exit 2
+}
+$dryRun = $trigger -eq '--dry-run'
+$automatic = $trigger -in @('--nightly','--low-space')
+$root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads/voidsworn_test'
+$temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Runner-Temp)).TrimEnd('\','/')
+$now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+$lock = $null; $script:log = $null
+try {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force)
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force)
+  $night = ''
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') {
+    $central = [TimeZoneInfo]::ConvertTimeBySystemTimeZoneId($now, 'Central Standard Time')
+    if ($central.Hour -lt 3) { exit 0 }
+    $night = $central.ToString('yyyyMMdd')
+  }
+  if (-not $dryRun) {
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { Write-Host 'janitor skipped during the PC pause'; exit 0 }
+    try { $lock = Open-JanitorLock (Join-Path $root 'janitor.lock') ($trigger -eq '--low-space') }
+    catch { Write-Host "janitor lock in use or unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 0 }
+    $now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+    if ($automatic -and (Test-RecentAutomaticRun $lock $trigger $now $night)) { exit 0 }
+  }
+  $drive = New-Object IO.DriveInfo([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($root))
+  $logPath = Join-Path $root "janitor_$((Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmm')).txt"
+  $logItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $logPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($logItem -and ($logItem -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($logItem.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw 'janitor log is not a plain file'
+  }
+  $script:log = New-Object IO.StreamWriter($logPath, $true, $utf8)
+  $script:log.AutoFlush = $true
+  $mode = if ($dryRun) { 'dry run' } elseif ($automatic) { $trigger } else { 'manual' }
+  Log "janitor $mode at $($now.ToString('o'))"
+  Log "free space before: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+  $mirror = Repo-Mirror
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d')) {
+    $board = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $board -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    try { Remove-OlderKeptRepos $board $mirror $dryRun }
+    catch { Log "kept lane $board (scan unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  }
+  $legacy = @{}
+  $legacyRuns = @(Get-LegacyRuns $root)
+  foreach ($run in $legacyRuns) { $legacy[[string]$run.State.scratch.path] = $run.Issue }
+  # Check old runners once, and take each current issue lock again immediately before making its decision.
+  $activeLegacy = @(Get-ActiveLegacyIssues $legacyRuns)
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force).EnumerateDirectories()) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^(voidsworn|issue|tune2-)') { continue }
+    $owned = $dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-run-*'
+    $issue = ''
+    if ($owned -and $dir.Name -match '^voidsworn-run-([1-9][0-9]*)-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    elseif ($owned) { $issue = $legacy[$dir.FullName] }
+    elseif ($dir.Name -match '^(?:issue|voidsworn(?:[-_](?:issue|parity))?|tune2)[-_]*([1-9][0-9]*)(?=[-_.]|$)') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    $why = if ($owned) { 'runner scratch' } elseif ($dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-parity-*') { 'parity scratch' } else { 'job scratch' }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $issue $why 3 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $owned
+  }
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force).EnumerateDirectories('opus*')) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^opus([1-9][0-9]*)(?:out.*)?$') { continue }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $Matches[1] 'helper folder' 24 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $false
+  }
+} catch {
+  if ($script:log) { Log "janitor stopped: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  else { Write-Host "janitor could not start: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  exit 1
+} finally {
+  if ($script:log) {
+    Log "free space after: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+    Log 'all done'
+    $script:log.Dispose()
+  }
+  if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() }
+}
+exit 0

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token

+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {

+      [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks -ne $record.created) { throw 'recorded directory was replaced' }

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
 }
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
+          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
+        }
+        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
+        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }

+# R336 PC cleanup. PowerShell 5.1. The Board reads --dry-run before the first live run.
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'runner_common.ps1') cleanup-library

+function Log($line) {
+  $script:log.WriteLine($line)
+  Write-Host $line

+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Test-RecentAutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $false
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { throw "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    if ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { throw "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    if ($owned) {
+      if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') { throw 'runner scratch name could not be verified' }
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}

+  }

+  # Check old runners once, and take each current issue lock again immediately before making its decision.
+  $activeLegacy = @(Get-ActiveLegacyIssues $legacyRuns)
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force).EnumerateDirectories()) {
