+    elseif ($owned) { $issue = $legacy[$dir.FullName] }
+    elseif ($dir.Name -match '^(?:issue|voidsworn(?:[-_](?:issue|parity))?|tune2)[-_]*([1-9][0-9]*)(?=[-_.]|$)') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    $why = if ($owned) { 'runner scratch' } elseif ($dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-parity-*') { 'parity scratch' } else { 'job scratch' }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $issue $why 3 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $owned

+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $Matches[1] 'helper folder' 24 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $false
+  }
+} catch {
+  if ($script:log) { Log "janitor stopped: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  else { Write-Host "janitor could not start: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  exit 1
+} finally {
+  if ($script:log) {
+    Log "free space after: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"

+}

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token
+}
+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {

+      [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks -ne $record.created) { throw 'recorded directory was replaced' }

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
 }
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
+          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
+        }
+        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
+        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
+        }
+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+    }
+  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try { $child.WaitForExit(); return $child.ExitCode }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }

+# R336 PC cleanup. PowerShell 5.1. The Board reads --dry-run before the first live run.
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'runner_common.ps1') cleanup-library
+
+function Log($line) {
+  $script:log.WriteLine($line)
+  Write-Host $line
+}
+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Test-RecentAutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $false
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { throw "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    if ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { throw "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    if ($owned) {
+      if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') { throw 'runner scratch name could not be verified' }
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}
+
+$trigger = $args[0]
+if ($args.Count -gt 1 -or $trigger -notin @($null,'--dry-run','--nightly','--low-space')) {
+  Write-Host 'usage: janitor.bat [--dry-run | --nightly | --low-space]'
+  exit 2
+}
+$dryRun = $trigger -eq '--dry-run'
+$automatic = $trigger -in @('--nightly','--low-space')
+$root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads/voidsworn_test'
+$temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Runner-Temp)).TrimEnd('\','/')
+$now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+$lock = $null; $script:log = $null
+try {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force)
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force)
+  $night = ''
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') {
+    $central = [TimeZoneInfo]::ConvertTimeBySystemTimeZoneId($now, 'Central Standard Time')
+    if ($central.Hour -lt 3) { exit 0 }
+    $night = $central.ToString('yyyyMMdd')
+  }
+  if (-not $dryRun) {
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { Write-Host 'janitor skipped during the PC pause'; exit 0 }
+    try { $lock = Open-JanitorLock (Join-Path $root 'janitor.lock') ($trigger -eq '--low-space') }
+    catch { Write-Host "janitor lock in use or unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 0 }
+    $now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+    if ($automatic -and (Test-RecentAutomaticRun $lock $trigger $now $night)) { exit 0 }
+  }
+  $drive = New-Object IO.DriveInfo([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($root))
+  $logPath = Join-Path $root "janitor_$((Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmm')).txt"
+  $logItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $logPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($logItem -and ($logItem -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($logItem.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw 'janitor log is not a plain file'
+  }
+  $script:log = New-Object IO.StreamWriter($logPath, $true, $utf8)
+  $script:log.AutoFlush = $true
+  $mode = if ($dryRun) { 'dry run' } elseif ($automatic) { $trigger } else { 'manual' }
+  Log "janitor $mode at $($now.ToString('o'))"
+  Log "free space before: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+  $mirror = Repo-Mirror
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d')) {
+    $board = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $board -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    try { Remove-OlderKeptRepos $board $mirror $dryRun }
+    catch { Log "kept lane $board (scan unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  }
+  $legacy = @{}
+  $legacyRuns = @(Get-LegacyRuns $root)
+  foreach ($run in $legacyRuns) { $legacy[[string]$run.State.scratch.path] = $run.Issue }
+  # Check old runners once, and take each current issue lock again immediately before making its decision.
+  $activeLegacy = @(Get-ActiveLegacyIssues $legacyRuns)
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force).EnumerateDirectories()) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^(voidsworn|issue|tune2-)') { continue }
+    $owned = $dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-run-*'
+    $issue = ''
+    if ($owned -and $dir.Name -match '^voidsworn-run-([1-9][0-9]*)-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    elseif ($owned) { $issue = $legacy[$dir.FullName] }
+    elseif ($dir.Name -match '^(?:issue|voidsworn(?:[-_](?:issue|parity))?|tune2)[-_]*([1-9][0-9]*)(?=[-_.]|$)') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    $why = if ($owned) { 'runner scratch' } elseif ($dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-parity-*') { 'parity scratch' } else { 'job scratch' }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $issue $why 3 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $owned
+  }
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force).EnumerateDirectories('opus*')) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^opus([1-9][0-9]*)(?:out.*)?$') { continue }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $Matches[1] 'helper folder' 24 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $false
+  }
+} catch {
+  if ($script:log) { Log "janitor stopped: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  else { Write-Host "janitor could not start: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  exit 1
+} finally {
+  if ($script:log) {
+    Log "free space after: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+    Log 'all done'
+    $script:log.Dispose()
+  }
+  if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() }
+}
+exit 0

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token
+}
+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {
+  $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:PC_RUN_TEMP).TrimEnd('\','/')
+  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($record.path)
+  if ($full -ne $record.path -or $full -ne $expected -or (Split-Path -Parent $full) -ne $temp -or
+      (Split-Path -Leaf $full) -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
+    throw 'recorded path does not match this run and its TEMP directory'
+  }
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { return }
+  $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $full -Force
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
+  if ((Read-ScratchOwner $full) -cne $record.token) { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  # Linux filesystems do not always expose a stable directory birth time.
+  if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT -and
+      [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks -ne $record.created) { throw 'recorded directory was replaced' }
+  return $dir
+}
+function Remove-CleanupDirectory($dir) {

+  if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop
+  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir.FullName) { throw 'directory could not be fully removed' }
+}

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
 }
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
+          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
+        }
+        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
+        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
+        }
+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+    }
+  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }
+}

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)

+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try { $child.WaitForExit(); return $child.ExitCode }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }

async function testAccounting() {
  // Issue 985: exercise real PS accounting with only token fixtures, never a key or provider call.
  const spendRoot = path.join(root, 'openai accounting'); fs.mkdirSync(spendRoot, { recursive: true });
  const spendOut = path.join(spendRoot, 'out'); write(path.join(spendOut, 'result.txt'), '');
  const spendSettings = path.join(spendRoot, 'runner_settings.txt');
  const ledger = path.join(spendRoot, 'openai_spend.txt');
  const workPS = args => runScript('work_issue.ps1', args, defaults);
  const budget = (model = openaiDefault, dry = '0') => workPS(['openai-budget', spendOut, spendRoot, spendSettings, model, dry]);
  const spend = (out = spendOut, model = openaiDefault, dry = '0') => workPS(['openai-spend', '985', out, spendRoot, spendSettings, model, dry]);
  const rows = () => read(ledger).trim().split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).map(s => JSON.parse(s));
  assert.equal((await workPS(['openai-key', spendOut])).code, 3);
  assert(read(path.join(spendOut, 'result.txt')).includes('no OpenAI API key saved: run OPENAI_API_KEY.bat'));
  assert.equal((await budget()).code, 0); // Missing setting defaults to 94.
  const event = (input, cached, output) => JSON.stringify({type:'step_finish',part:{tokens:{input,output,reasoning:100000,cache:{read:cached,write:0}}}}) + '\n';
  write(path.join(spendOut, 'events.jsonl'), event(1000000, 2000000, 3000000));
  write(path.join(spendOut, 'preflight_log.txt'), event(100000, 100000, 100000));
  assert.equal((await spend()).code, 0);
  assert.equal(rows()[0].model, openaiDefault);
  assert.equal(rows().length, 1); assert.equal(rows()[0].estimated_usd, 35.41);
  assert.equal(rows()[0].running_total_usd, 35.41); assert.equal(rows()[0].budget_usd, 94);
  assert.equal(rows()[0].input, 1100000); assert.equal(rows()[0].cached_input, 2100000); assert.equal(rows()[0].output, 3300000);
  assert.equal((await spend()).code, 0); assert.equal(rows().length, 1, 'finish must not double record');
  assert(read(path.join(spendOut, 'result.txt')).includes('OpenAI estimate USD: 35.41'));
  write(spendSettings, 'openai_budget_usd=35.41\n');
  assert.equal((await budget()).code, 3); assert(read(path.join(spendOut, 'result.txt')).includes('OpenAI budget reached'));
  assert.equal((await budget('openai/gpt-6.1-sol', '1')).code, 0, 'dry run ignores real spend');
  assert.equal((await budget('openai/gpt-6.1-sol')).code, 3, 'legacy model stays priced and shares the same budget');
  write(spendSettings, 'openai_budget_usd=36\n'); assert.equal((await budget()).code, 0);
  write(spendSettings, 'openai_budget_usd=oops\n'); assert.equal((await budget()).code, 3);
  write(spendSettings, 'openai_budget_usd=94\n'); assert.equal((await budget('openai/unpriced')).code, 3);
  const old = rows()[0]; old.date = '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'; write(ledger, JSON.stringify(old) + '\n');
  write(spendSettings, 'openai_budget_usd=1\n'); assert.equal((await budget()).code, 0, 'previous month does not spend this month');
  const terraOut = path.join(spendRoot, 'terra'); write(path.join(terraOut, 'result.txt'), '');
  write(path.join(terraOut, 'events.jsonl'), event(1000000, 2000000, 3000000));
  assert.equal((await spend(terraOut, openaiReview)).code, 0);
  assert.equal(rows()[1].estimated_usd, 16.6); assert.equal(rows()[1].running_total_usd, 16.6);
  assert.equal((await budget()).code, 3, 'run crossing budget stops the next start');
  const beforeDry = read(ledger); assert.equal((await spend(terraOut, openaiReview, '1')).code, 0);
  assert.equal(read(ledger), beforeDry);
  const unknownOut = path.join(spendRoot, 'unknown'); write(path.join(unknownOut, 'result.txt'), '');
  write(path.join(unknownOut, 'preflight_log.txt'), '{"type":"error","error":{"message":"fixture failed probe"}}\n');
  assert.equal((await spend(unknownOut)).code, 3); assert.equal(rows()[2].status, 'unknown');
  write(spendSettings, 'openai_budget_usd=94\n'); assert.equal((await budget()).code, 3);
  assert(read(path.join(spendOut, 'result.txt')).includes('OpenAI usage unknown'));
  write(ledger, 'bad ledger\n'); assert.equal((await budget()).code, 3);
  pass('OpenAI missing key, named prices, probe plus agent usage, idempotent ledger, default/configured budget, dry isolation, month rollover and unknown-usage refusal');
}

+# R336 PC cleanup. PowerShell 5.1. The Board reads --dry-run before the first live run.
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'runner_common.ps1') cleanup-library

+function Log($line) {
+  $script:log.WriteLine($line)
+  Write-Host $line

+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Test-RecentAutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $true }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $false
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { throw "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    if ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { throw "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    if ($owned) {
+      if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') { throw 'runner scratch name could not be verified' }
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}

+$trigger = $args[0]
+if ($args.Count -gt 1 -or $trigger -notin @($null,'--dry-run','--nightly','--low-space')) {
+  Write-Host 'usage: janitor.bat [--dry-run | --nightly | --low-space]'
+  exit 2
+}
+$dryRun = $trigger -eq '--dry-run'
+$automatic = $trigger -in @('--nightly','--low-space')
+$root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads/voidsworn_test'
+$temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Runner-Temp)).TrimEnd('\','/')
+$now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+$lock = $null; $script:log = $null
+try {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force)
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force)
+  $night = ''
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') {
+    $central = [TimeZoneInfo]::ConvertTimeBySystemTimeZoneId($now, 'Central Standard Time')
+    if ($central.Hour -lt 3) { exit 0 }
+    $night = $central.ToString('yyyyMMdd')
+  }
+  if (-not $dryRun) {
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { Write-Host 'janitor skipped during the PC pause'; exit 0 }
+    try { $lock = Open-JanitorLock (Join-Path $root 'janitor.lock') ($trigger -eq '--low-space') }
+    catch { Write-Host "janitor lock in use or unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 0 }
+    $now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+    if ($automatic -and (Test-RecentAutomaticRun $lock $trigger $now $night)) { exit 0 }
+  }
+  $drive = New-Object IO.DriveInfo([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($root))
+  $logPath = Join-Path $root "janitor_$((Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmm')).txt"
+  $logItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $logPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($logItem -and ($logItem -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($logItem.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw 'janitor log is not a plain file'
+  }
+  $script:log = New-Object IO.StreamWriter($logPath, $true, $utf8)
+  $script:log.AutoFlush = $true
+  $mode = if ($dryRun) { 'dry run' } elseif ($automatic) { $trigger } else { 'manual' }
+  Log "janitor $mode at $($now.ToString('o'))"
+  Log "free space before: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+  $mirror = Repo-Mirror
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d')) {
+    $board = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $board -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    try { Remove-OlderKeptRepos $board $mirror $dryRun }
+    catch { Log "kept lane $board (scan unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  }
+  $legacy = @{}
+  $legacyRuns = @(Get-LegacyRuns $root)
+  foreach ($run in $legacyRuns) { $legacy[[string]$run.State.scratch.path] = $run.Issue }
+  # Check old runners once, and take each current issue lock again immediately before making its decision.
+  $activeLegacy = @(Get-ActiveLegacyIssues $legacyRuns)
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force).EnumerateDirectories()) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^(voidsworn|issue|tune2-)') { continue }
+    $owned = $dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-run-*'
+    $issue = ''
+    if ($owned -and $dir.Name -match '^voidsworn-run-([1-9][0-9]*)-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    elseif ($owned) { $issue = $legacy[$dir.FullName] }
+    elseif ($dir.Name -match '^(?:issue|voidsworn(?:[-_](?:issue|parity))?|tune2)[-_]*([1-9][0-9]*)(?=[-_.]|$)') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    $why = if ($owned) { 'runner scratch' } elseif ($dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-parity-*') { 'parity scratch' } else { 'job scratch' }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $issue $why 3 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $owned
+  }
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force).EnumerateDirectories('opus*')) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^opus([1-9][0-9]*)(?:out.*)?$') { continue }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $Matches[1] 'helper folder' 24 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $false
+  }
+} catch {
+  if ($script:log) { Log "janitor stopped: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  else { Write-Host "janitor could not start: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  exit 1
+} finally {
+  if ($script:log) {
+    Log "free space after: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+    Log 'all done'
+    $script:log.Dispose()
+  }
+  if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() }
+}
+exit 0

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token
+}
+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {
+  $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:PC_RUN_TEMP).TrimEnd('\','/')
+  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($record.path)
+  if ($full -ne $record.path -or $full -ne $expected -or (Split-Path -Parent $full) -ne $temp -or
+      (Split-Path -Leaf $full) -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
+    throw 'recorded path does not match this run and its TEMP directory'
+  }
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { return }
+  $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $full -Force
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
+  if ((Read-ScratchOwner $full) -cne $record.token) { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  # Linux filesystems do not always expose a stable directory birth time.
+  if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT -and
+      [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks -ne $record.created) { throw 'recorded directory was replaced' }
+  return $dir
+}

+  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir.FullName) { throw 'directory could not be fully removed' }

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try {
+      $stderr = $child.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
+      while ($null -ne ($line = $child.StandardOutput.ReadLine())) { Write-Host $line }
+      $child.WaitForExit()
+      $errors = $stderr.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+      if ($errors) { [Console]::Error.Write($errors) }
+      return $child.ExitCode
+    }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
+}

// Most scenarios need real Git only. Avoid a cmd + Node + Git process tree for every harmless Git call.

function gitEnvironment(env) {
  return { ...env, PC_TEST_GIT: env.STUB_GIT_FAULT || env.STUB_CHECKOUT_EDIT || env.STUB_RECHECK_FAIL || env.STUB_FETCH_HOLD ? gitStub : gitPath };

// Copy the launchers and run their real helpers through the warm fixture shell.
// Only the agent watchdog is replaced. Its preflight kill path and the separate
// runner_stall_tests row still exercise the real timeout code.
function fixtureTools(name, scenario = '') {
  const dir = path.join(root, name);
  for (const file of ['codex_issue.bat', 'codex_issue.ps1', 'work_issue.bat', 'work_issue.ps1', 'runner_common.ps1', 'review_evidence.ps1', 'run_timeout.ps1', 'gpu_slots.js']) {
    let body = read(path.join(here, file));
    if (file.endsWith('.bat')) {
      body = body.replace(/powershell -NoProfile (?:-ExecutionPolicy Bypass )?(?=-File |-Command "(?:\(Get-Date\)|Get-Date -Format))/g,
        'node "%RUNNER_FIXTURE_PS%" ').replace(/\r?\n/g, '\r\n');
      if (scenario === 'accounting' && file === 'work_issue.bat') {
        body = body.replace(/(%PS% openai-(?:budget|spend)[^\r\n]*)"%DRY%"/g, '$1"0"')
          .replace('set "PUSHMODE=dry"', 'set "PUSHMODE=test"');
      }
      if (scenario === 'delivery' && file === 'work_issue.bat') {
        // Keep dryrun's mock agent and fake GitHub. Exercise real delivery logic against a bare TEMP remote.
        body = body.replace('set "PUSHMODE=dry"', 'set "PUSHMODE=real"')
          .replace(/(%PS% tidy[^\r\n]*?) "?%DRY%"?(?= >>)/, '$1 0');
      }
    }
    write(path.join(dir, file), body);
  }
  write(path.join(dir, 'tmo.bat'), [
    '@echo off',
    'setlocal',
    'if not "%PC_RUNNER_TEST%"=="1" exit /b 125',
    'set "STUB_WATCHDOG_ARGS=%*"',
    'node "' + path.join(root, 'watchdog.js') + '"',
    'exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%'
  ].join('\r\n') + '\r\n');
  return dir;
}

async function job(arm, label, extra = {}) {

'use strict';
// The copied batch files use this client. The parent balances calls over warm
// Windows PowerShell processes, each handling one request at a time.
const net = require('net');
const path = require('path');
const readline = require('readline');
const { randomUUID } = require('crypto');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');

function request(options, env, cwd) {
  return { ...options, env, cwd };
}

if (require.main === module) {
  const [flag, target, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2);
  const invocation = flag === '-File' ? { file: target, args } : { command: target, args };
  const socket = net.createConnection(process.env.RUNNER_FIXTURE_PIPE);
  let output = '';
  socket.setEncoding('utf8');
  socket.on('connect', () => socket.write(JSON.stringify(request(invocation, process.env, process.cwd())) + '\n'));
  socket.on('data', chunk => output += chunk);
  socket.on('end', () => {
    try {
      const { code, stdout, stderr, error } = JSON.parse(output);
      if (error) throw new Error(error);
      for (const line of stdout) console.log(line);
      for (const line of stderr) console.error(line);
      process.exitCode = code;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Runner fixture shell: ' + e.message);
      process.exitCode = 125;
    }
  });
}

module.exports = async function startShell(root, size, scriptDirs) {
  const pipe = '\\\\.\\pipe\\voidsworn-runner-selftest-' + randomUUID();
  const allowedFiles = new Set(scriptDirs.flatMap(dir => ['runner_common.ps1', 'codex_issue.ps1', 'work_issue.ps1', 'review_evidence.ps1']
    .map(name => path.join(dir, name).toLowerCase())));
  const allowedCommands = new Set(["(Get-Date).ToString('s')", 'Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmmss']);
  const queue = [];
  const hosts = [];
  const clients = new Set();
  let stopped = false;
  let fault;

  function drain() {
    for (const host of hosts) {
      if (stopped || !queue.length) break;
      if (host.pending || host.dead) continue;
      host.pending = queue.shift();
      host.timer = setTimeout(() => {
        host.fail(new Error('PowerShell fixture step timed out: ' + host.pending.input));
        host.child.kill();
      }, 90000);
      host.child.stdin.write(host.pending.payload + '\n');
    }
  }

  // Keep the original launcher paths in child environments so the real helpers
  // still launch their own subprocesses, including the preflight kill test.
  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    const child = spawn('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', path.join(__dirname, 'runner_selftest_shell.ps1')], {
      cwd: root, windowsHide: true
    });
    const host = { child };
    let errors = '';
    const closed = new Promise(resolve => child.once('close', resolve));
    host.closed = closed;
    host.fail = error => {
      if (!stopped) fault ??= error;
      host.dead = true;
      clearTimeout(host.timer);
      if (host.pending) host.pending.reject(error);
      host.pending = null;
      if (hosts.every(h => h.dead)) {
        for (const item of queue.splice(0)) item.reject(error);
      } else drain();
    };
    hosts.push(host);
    child.stderr.setEncoding('utf8');
    child.stderr.on('data', chunk => errors += chunk);
    child.on('error', host.fail);
    child.stdin.on('error', host.fail);
    child.once('close', code => host.fail(new Error('PowerShell fixture host exited (' + code + '): ' + errors)));
    readline.createInterface({ input: child.stdout }).on('line', line => {
      if (!host.pending) return;
      const { resolve } = host.pending;
      try {
        const result = JSON.parse(line);
        if (!Number.isInteger(result.code)) throw new Error('Missing PowerShell exit code');
        clearTimeout(host.timer);
        host.pending = null;
        resolve(result);
        drain();
      } catch (e) {
        host.fail(new Error('Invalid PowerShell fixture reply: ' + e.message + '\n' + line));
        child.kill();
      }
    });
  }

  function invoke(input) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      if (stopped || hosts.every(h => h.dead)) return reject(new Error('No PowerShell fixture hosts are available'));
      queue.push({ input: input.file ? path.basename(input.file) + ':' + input.args[0] : '-Command', payload: JSON.stringify(input), resolve, reject });
      drain();
    });
  }

  const server = net.createServer(socket => {
    clients.add(socket);
    socket.on('close', () => clients.delete(socket));
    socket.on('error', () => socket.destroy());
    const input = readline.createInterface({ input: socket });
    input.once('line', async raw => {
      input.close();
      try {
        const call = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (call.file ? !allowedFiles.has(call.file.toLowerCase()) : !allowedCommands.has(call.command)) {
          throw new Error('Unexpected PowerShell fixture command');
        }
        socket.end(JSON.stringify(await invoke(call)));
      }
      catch (e) {
        fault ??= e;
        socket.end(JSON.stringify({ error: e.message }));
      }
    });
  });
  assert(!fs.existsSync(noStart.repo));
  pass('a low-disk run stops before the mirror, the model probe and the agent');
  // The Board writes work217\runner_hashes.txt with hashwrite after copying the runner and watchdog files; hashcheck then
  // guards the running copies. A mismatch or a missing file is a warning, never a stop.
  const runnerFiles = ['codex_issue.bat', 'codex_issue.ps1', 'runner_common.ps1', 'work_issue.bat', 'work_issue.ps1', 'review_evidence.ps1', 'run_timeout.ps1', 'tmo.bat', 'gpu_slots.js'];
  const hashesGood = path.join(root, 'board_hashes_good.txt');
  write(hashesGood, runnerFiles.map(n => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(path.join(here, n))).digest('hex') + '  ' + n).join('\n') + '\n');
  const hashOut = path.join(root, 'hashcheck'); fs.mkdirSync(hashOut); write(path.join(hashOut, 'result.txt'), '');
  assert.equal((await ps(['init', hashOut, 'fixture/hash'], defaults)).code, 0);
  const hashesWritten = path.join(root, 'board_hashes_written.txt');
  assert.equal((await ps(['hashwrite', here, hashesWritten], defaults)).code, 0);
  assert.equal(read(hashesWritten), read(hashesGood));
  assert.equal((await ps(['hashcheck', hashOut, here, hashesGood], defaults)).code, 0);
  assert(read(path.join(hashOut, 'result.txt')).includes(`runner files match the Board hashes (${runnerFiles.length} checked)`));
  pass('hashwrite and hashcheck agree on the runner and watchdog files');
  const hashesBad = path.join(root, 'board_hashes_bad.txt');
  write(hashesBad, read(hashesGood).split('\n').map(l => l.endsWith('runner_common.ps1') ? '0'.repeat(64) + '  runner_common.ps1' : l).join('\n'));
  assert.equal((await ps(['hashcheck', hashOut, here, hashesBad], defaults)).code, 0);
  assert(read(path.join(hashOut, 'result.txt')).includes('WARNING: these runner files differ from the Board-copied hashes: runner_common.ps1'));
  assert.equal((await ps(['hashcheck', hashOut, here, path.join(root, 'no_such_hashes.txt')], defaults)).code, 0);
  assert(read(path.join(hashOut, 'result.txt')).includes('WARNING: no Board hashes file'));
  pass('a hash mismatch and a missing hashes file warn without stopping');
  const hashWarn = await job('deepseek', 'hashwarn', { PC_TEST_HASHES: hashesBad });
  assert.equal(hashWarn.code, 0, hashWarn.text + '\n' + hashWarn.result);
  assert(fs.existsSync(path.join(hashWarn.repo, 'agent_started.txt')));
  assert(hashWarn.result.includes('WARNING: these runner files differ'), hashWarn.result);
  pass('a run whose tools folder drifts from the Board hashes still starts and warns');
}

+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Reserve-AutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $true
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $busy = ''
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { $busy = "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    elseif ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { $busy = "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($busy) { throw $busy }
+    if ($owned) {
+      if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') { throw 'runner scratch name could not be verified' }
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}

+  exit 2
+}

+$automatic = $trigger -in @('--nightly','--low-space')

+    catch { Write-Host "janitor lock in use or unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 0 }

+}

+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token
+}
+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {
+  $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:PC_RUN_TEMP).TrimEnd('\','/')
+  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($record.path)
+  if ($full -ne $record.path -or $full -ne $expected -or (Split-Path -Parent $full) -ne $temp -or
+      (Split-Path -Leaf $full) -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
+    throw 'recorded path does not match this run and its TEMP directory'
+  }
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { return }
+  $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $full -Force
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
+  if ((Read-ScratchOwner $full) -cne $record.token) { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  # Linux filesystems do not always expose a stable directory birth time.
+  if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT -and
+      [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks -ne $record.created) { throw 'recorded directory was replaced' }
+  return $dir
+}
+function Remove-CleanupDirectory($dir) {

+  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop
+  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir.FullName) { throw 'directory could not be fully removed' }
+}

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw 'retry marker is not a plain file'
+  }

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try {
+      $stderr = $child.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
+      while ($null -ne ($line = $child.StandardOutput.ReadLine())) { Write-Host $line }
+      $child.WaitForExit()
+      $errors = $stderr.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+      if ($errors) { [Console]::Error.Write($errors) }
+      return $child.ExitCode
+    }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
+}

+# R336 PC cleanup. PowerShell 5.1. The Board reads --dry-run before the first live run.
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'runner_common.ps1') cleanup-library

+function Log($line) {
+  $script:log.WriteLine($line)
+  Write-Host $line
+}
+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Reserve-AutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $true
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $busy = ''
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { $busy = "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    elseif ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { $busy = "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($busy) { throw $busy }
+    if ($owned) {
+      if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') { throw 'runner scratch name could not be verified' }
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}
+
+$trigger = $args[0]
+if ($args.Count -gt 1 -or $trigger -notin @($null,'--dry-run','--nightly','--low-space')) {
+  Write-Host 'usage: janitor.bat [--dry-run | --nightly | --low-space]'
+  exit 2
+}
+$dryRun = $trigger -eq '--dry-run'
+$automatic = $trigger -in @('--nightly','--low-space')
+$root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads/voidsworn_test'
+$temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Runner-Temp)).TrimEnd('\','/')
+$now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+$lock = $null; $script:log = $null
+try {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force)
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force)
+  $night = ''
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') {
+    $central = [TimeZoneInfo]::ConvertTimeBySystemTimeZoneId($now, 'Central Standard Time')
+    if ($central.Hour -lt 3) { exit 0 }
+    $night = $central.ToString('yyyyMMdd')
+  }
+  if (-not $dryRun) {
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) {
+      if ($trigger -ne '--nightly') { Write-Host 'janitor skipped during the PC pause' }
+      exit 0
+    }
+    try { $lock = Open-JanitorLock (Join-Path $root 'janitor.lock') ($trigger -eq '--low-space') }
+    catch { Write-Host "janitor lock in use or unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 0 }
+    $now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+    if ($automatic -and -not (Reserve-AutomaticRun $lock $trigger $now $night)) { exit 0 }
+  }
+  $drive = New-Object IO.DriveInfo([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($root))
+  $logPath = Join-Path $root "janitor_$((Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmm')).txt"
+  $logItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $logPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($logItem -and ($logItem -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($logItem.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw 'janitor log is not a plain file'
+  }
+  $script:log = New-Object IO.StreamWriter($logPath, $true, $utf8)
+  $script:log.AutoFlush = $true
+  $mode = if ($dryRun) { 'dry run' } elseif ($automatic) { $trigger } else { 'manual' }
+  Log "janitor $mode at $($now.ToString('o'))"
+  Log "free space before: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+  $mirror = Repo-Mirror
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d')) {
+    $board = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $board -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    try { Remove-OlderKeptRepos $board $mirror $dryRun }
+    catch { Log "kept lane $board (scan unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  }
+  $legacy = @{}
+  $legacyRuns = @(Get-LegacyRuns $root)
+  foreach ($run in $legacyRuns) { $legacy[[string]$run.State.scratch.path] = $run.Issue }
+  # Check old runners once, and take each current issue lock again immediately before making its decision.
+  $activeLegacy = @(Get-ActiveLegacyIssues $legacyRuns)
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force).EnumerateDirectories()) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^(voidsworn|issue|tune2-)') { continue }
+    $owned = $dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-run-*'
+    $issue = ''
+    if ($owned -and $dir.Name -match '^voidsworn-run-([1-9][0-9]*)-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    elseif ($owned) { $issue = $legacy[$dir.FullName] }
+    elseif ($dir.Name -match '^(?:issue|voidsworn(?:[-_](?:issue|parity))?|tune2)[-_]*([1-9][0-9]*)(?=[-_.]|$)') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    $why = if ($owned) { 'runner scratch' } elseif ($dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-parity-*') { 'parity scratch' } else { 'job scratch' }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $issue $why 3 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $owned
+  }
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force).EnumerateDirectories('opus*')) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^opus([1-9][0-9]*)(?:out.*)?$') { continue }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $Matches[1] 'helper folder' 24 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $false
+  }
+} catch {
+  if ($script:log) { Log "janitor stopped: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  else { Write-Host "janitor could not start: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  exit 1
+} finally {
+  if ($script:log) {
+    Log "free space after: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+    Log 'all done'
+    $script:log.Dispose()
+  }
+  if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() }
+}
+exit 0

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token
+}
+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {
+  $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:PC_RUN_TEMP).TrimEnd('\','/')
+  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($record.path)
+  if ($full -ne $record.path -or $full -ne $expected -or (Split-Path -Parent $full) -ne $temp -or
+      (Split-Path -Leaf $full) -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
+    throw 'recorded path does not match this run and its TEMP directory'
+  }
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { return }
+  $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $full -Force
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
+  if ((Read-ScratchOwner $full) -cne $record.token) { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  # Linux filesystems do not always expose a stable directory birth time.
+  if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT -and

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
+          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
+        }
+        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
+        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
+        }
+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+    }
+  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }
+}

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try {
+      $stderr = $child.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
+      while ($null -ne ($line = $child.StandardOutput.ReadLine())) { Write-Host $line }
+      $child.WaitForExit()
+      $errors = $stderr.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+      if ($errors) { [Console]::Error.Write($errors) }
+      return $child.ExitCode
+    }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
+}
