+# R336 PC cleanup. PowerShell 5.1. The Board reads --dry-run before the first live run.
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'runner_common.ps1') cleanup-library
+
+function Log($line) {
+  $script:log.WriteLine($line)
+  Write-Host $line
+}
+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Reserve-AutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $true
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $busy = ''
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { $busy = "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    elseif ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { $busy = "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($busy) { throw $busy }
+    if ($owned) {
+      if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') { throw 'runner scratch name could not be verified' }
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}
+
+$trigger = $args[0]
+if ($args.Count -gt 1 -or $trigger -notin @($null,'--dry-run','--nightly','--low-space')) {
+  Write-Host 'usage: janitor.bat [--dry-run | --nightly | --low-space]'
+  exit 2
+}
+$dryRun = $trigger -eq '--dry-run'
+$automatic = $trigger -in @('--nightly','--low-space')
+$root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads/voidsworn_test'
+$temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Runner-Temp)).TrimEnd('\','/')
+$now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+$lock = $null; $script:log = $null
+try {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force)
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force)
+  $night = ''
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') {
+    $central = [TimeZoneInfo]::ConvertTimeBySystemTimeZoneId($now, 'Central Standard Time')
+    if ($central.Hour -lt 3) { exit 0 }
+    $night = $central.ToString('yyyyMMdd')
+  }
+  if (-not $dryRun) {
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) {
+      if ($trigger -ne '--nightly') { Write-Host 'janitor skipped during the PC pause' }
+      exit 0
+    }
+    try { $lock = Open-JanitorLock (Join-Path $root 'janitor.lock') ($trigger -eq '--low-space') }
+    catch { Write-Host "janitor lock in use or unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 0 }
+    $now = [DateTime]::UtcNow
+    if ($automatic -and -not (Reserve-AutomaticRun $lock $trigger $now $night)) { exit 0 }
+  }
+  $drive = New-Object IO.DriveInfo([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($root))
+  $logPath = Join-Path $root "janitor_$((Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmm')).txt"
+  $logItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $logPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($logItem -and ($logItem -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($logItem.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw 'janitor log is not a plain file'
+  }
+  $script:log = New-Object IO.StreamWriter($logPath, $true, $utf8)
+  $script:log.AutoFlush = $true
+  $mode = if ($dryRun) { 'dry run' } elseif ($automatic) { $trigger } else { 'manual' }
+  Log "janitor $mode at $($now.ToString('o'))"
+  Log "free space before: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+  $mirror = Repo-Mirror
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d')) {
+    $board = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $board -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    try { Remove-OlderKeptRepos $board $mirror $dryRun }
+    catch { Log "kept lane $board (scan unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  }
+  $legacy = @{}
+  $legacyRuns = @(Get-LegacyRuns $root)
+  foreach ($run in $legacyRuns) { $legacy[[string]$run.State.scratch.path] = $run.Issue }
+  # Check old runners once, and take each current issue lock again immediately before making its decision.
+  $activeLegacy = @(Get-ActiveLegacyIssues $legacyRuns)
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force).EnumerateDirectories()) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^(voidsworn|issue|tune2-)') { continue }
+    $owned = $dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-run-*'
+    $issue = ''
+    if ($owned -and $dir.Name -match '^voidsworn-run-([1-9][0-9]*)-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    elseif ($owned) { $issue = $legacy[$dir.FullName] }
+    elseif ($dir.Name -match '^(?:issue|voidsworn(?:[-_](?:issue|parity))?|tune2)[-_]*([1-9][0-9]*)(?=[-_.]|$)') { $issue = $Matches[1] }
+    $why = if ($owned) { 'runner scratch' } elseif ($dir.Name -like 'voidsworn-parity-*') { 'parity scratch' } else { 'job scratch' }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $issue $why 3 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $owned
+  }
+  foreach ($dir in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $root -Force).EnumerateDirectories('opus*')) {
+    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^opus([1-9][0-9]*)(?:out.*)?$') { continue }
+    Clear-ScratchFolder $dir $Matches[1] 'helper folder' 24 $temp $now $dryRun $activeLegacy $false
+  }
+} catch {
+  if ($script:log) { Log "janitor stopped: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  else { Write-Host "janitor could not start: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
+  exit 1
+} finally {
+  if ($script:log) {
+    Log "free space after: $($drive.AvailableFreeSpace) bytes"
+    Log 'all done'
+    $script:log.Dispose()
+  }
+  if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() }
+}
+exit 0

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token
+}
+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {
+  $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:PC_RUN_TEMP).TrimEnd('\','/')
+  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($record.path)
+  if ($full -ne $record.path -or $full -ne $expected -or (Split-Path -Parent $full) -ne $temp -or
+      (Split-Path -Leaf $full) -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
+    throw 'recorded path does not match this run and its TEMP directory'
+  }
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { return }
+  $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $full -Force
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
+  if ((Read-ScratchOwner $full) -cne $record.token) { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  # Linux filesystems do not always expose a stable directory birth time.
+  if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT -and
+      [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks -ne $record.created) { throw 'recorded directory was replaced' }
+  return $dir
+}

+  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir.FullName) { throw 'directory could not be fully removed' }

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

   }

 }
+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
+          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
+        }
+        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
+        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
+        }
+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+    }
+  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }
+}

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try {
+      $stderr = $child.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
+      while ($null -ne ($line = $child.StandardOutput.ReadLine())) { Write-Host $line }
+      $child.WaitForExit()
+      $errors = $stderr.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+      if ($errors) { [Console]::Error.Write($errors) }
+      return $child.ExitCode
+    }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
+}

+# R336 PC cleanup. PowerShell 5.1. The Board reads --dry-run before the first live run.
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'runner_common.ps1') cleanup-library

+function Log($line) {
+  $script:log.WriteLine($line)
+  Write-Host $line
+}
+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Reserve-AutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $true
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $busy = ''
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { $busy = "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    elseif ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { $busy = "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($busy) { throw $busy }
+    if ($owned) {
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}

+if ($args.Count -gt 1 -or $trigger -notin @($null,'--dry-run','--nightly','--low-space')) {
+  Write-Host 'usage: janitor.bat [--dry-run | --nightly | --low-space]'
+  exit 2
+}

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token
+}
+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
+          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
+        }
+        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
+        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
+        }
+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+    }
+  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try {
+      $stderr = $child.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
+      while ($null -ne ($line = $child.StandardOutput.ReadLine())) { Write-Host $line }
+      $child.WaitForExit()
+      $errors = $stderr.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+      if ($errors) { [Console]::Error.Write($errors) }
+      return $child.ExitCode
+    }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
+}

function object(type, value) {
  const b = Buffer.isBuffer(value) ? value : Buffer.from(value);
  const raw = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(type + ' ' + b.length + '\0'), b]);

  return id;
}

+# R336 PC cleanup. PowerShell 5.1. The Board reads --dry-run before the first live run.
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'runner_common.ps1') cleanup-library

+function Log($line) {
+  $script:log.WriteLine($line)
+  Write-Host $line
+}
+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Reserve-AutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $true
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $busy = ''
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { $busy = "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    elseif ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { $busy = "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($busy) { throw $busy }
+    if ($owned) {
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}
+
+$trigger = $args[0]
+if ($args.Count -gt 1 -or $trigger -notin @($null,'--dry-run','--nightly','--low-space')) {
+  Write-Host 'usage: janitor.bat [--dry-run | --nightly | --low-space]'
+  exit 2

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }
+  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token

+function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'

+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {

+        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"

+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try {
+      $stderr = $child.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
+      while ($null -ne ($line = $child.StandardOutput.ReadLine())) { Write-Host $line }
+      $child.WaitForExit()
+      $errors = $stderr.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+      if ($errors) { [Console]::Error.Write($errors) }
+      return $child.ExitCode
+    }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
+}

async function testAssignedBranch() {
  await parallel([
    ['codex', 'moved-seat', 'Branch: assigns'],
    ['deepseek', 'moved-arm', 'Branch: assigns'],
    ['codex', 'moved-owner', 'Owner: muse does not match']
  ], async ([arm, scenario, reason]) => {
    const r = await job(arm, scenario);
    assert.equal(r.code, 14, r.text + r.result);
    assert(r.result.includes(reason), r.result);
    assert(!fs.existsSync(r.repo) && !fs.existsSync(r.env.PC_TEST_TRACE), 'assignment refusal precedes checkout and model calls');
    const calls = read(r.env.PC_TEST_GH_TRACE).trim().split(/\r?\n/).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
    assert(calls.length && calls.every(c => c.method === 'GET'), 'assignment refusal precedes any claim');
    pass(arm + ': ' + scenario + ' refuses before any claim or agent call');
  });
  const override = 'fixture/assigned-issue-687';
  const source = fixtureSource('assigned-branch');
  write(path.join(source, 'refs/heads', override + '-partial'), partial + '\n');
  const r = await job('codex', 'test-push-override', { PC_TEST_SOURCE: source, CODEX_TEST_BRANCH: override });
  assert.equal(r.code, 0, r.text + r.result);
  assert.equal(r.state.branch, override);
  assert(fs.existsSync(path.join(r.repo, 'agent_started.txt')));
  pass('fixture push override still validates the issue against the actual Codex assignment');
}
async function testLaneOwnership() {
  const profile = path.join(root, 'fixture profile');
  const home = path.join(profile, 'Downloads', 'voidsworn_test', 'board_d');
  const out = path.join(home, 'issue-687');
  const agentHold = path.join(root, 'agent hold');
  const finishHold = path.join(root, 'finish hold');
  const commonEnv = { CODEX_TEST_ROOT: home, USERPROFILE: profile };
  const waiting = job('codex', 'lane-lock', { ...commonEnv, STUB_AGENT_HOLD: agentHold, PC_TEST_GH_HOLD_FINISH: finishHold })
    .catch(error => ({ error }));
  async function refuse(issue) {
    const db = path.join(home, 'contender-gh.json');
    const trace = path.join(home, 'contender-gh.jsonl');
    write(db, JSON.stringify(gh.database(issue, base, { running: issue === 687 }))); write(trace, '');
    const r = await runEntryPoint('""' + path.join(tools, 'codex_issue.bat') + '" ' + issue + '"', {
      ...defaults, ...commonEnv, PC_TEST_MIRROR: path.join(home, 'mirror.git'), PC_TEST_GH_DB: db, PC_TEST_GH_TRACE: trace,
      PC_TEST_TRACE: path.join(home, 'contender-probe.txt')
    });
    assert.equal(r.code, 14, r.text);
    assert(r.text.includes('cannot take the Codex checkout lock'), r.text);
    assert.equal(read(trace), '', 'contender cannot contact GitHub or claim an issue');
    assert(!fs.existsSync(path.join(home, 'contender-probe.txt')));
  }
  let winner;
  try {
    assert(await waitFor(() => fs.existsSync(agentHold + '.ready'), 45000), 'mock agent never reached its checkout');
    const watched = [path.join(out, 'status.json'), path.join(out, 'result.txt'), path.join(home, 'repo', 'CODEX_TASK.md'),
      path.join(home, 'repo', '.git', 'HEAD'), path.join(home, 'repo', 'agent_started.txt')];
    const before = watched.map(read);
    await refuse(687);
    await refuse(688);
    assert.deepEqual(watched.map(read), before, 'the live checkout, work and run records must be untouched');
    assert(!fs.existsSync(path.join(home, 'issue-688')), 'a different issue cannot create its output folder on this lane');
    write(agentHold + '.release', 'agent may finish');
    assert(await waitFor(() => fs.existsSync(finishHold + '.ready'), 30000), 'runner never reached final reporting');
    assert.equal(JSON.parse(read(path.join(out, 'status.json'))).status, 'unverified', 'local state was already finalized');
    await refuse(687);
    const refresh = run('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File',
      path.join(here, 'lane_tools_refresh.ps1'), '-Build', 'build_e'], { USERPROFILE: profile });
    assert.equal(refresh.code, 1, refresh.text);
    assert(refresh.text.includes('Codex checkout lock is busy'), refresh.text);
  } finally {
    write(agentHold + '.release', 'released');
    write(finishHold + '.release', 'released');
    winner = await waiting;
  }
  if (winner.error) throw winner.error;
  assert.equal(winner.code, 0, winner.text + winner.result);
  const next = await job('codex', 'lane-lock-retry', commonEnv);
  assert.equal(next.code, 0, next.text + next.result);
  assert.notEqual(next.state.run, winner.state.run);
  pass('Codex refuses same-issue and different-issue launches before writes, blocks refresh during final reporting, and releases the lane');
}
async function testDeliveryCleanup() {
  await parallel([
    ['failed-checks', 'unverified', { STUB_CHECKS_EXIT: '1' }],
    ['partial', 'partial', { STUB_AGENT_EXIT: '1' }],
    ['ignored-work', 'checked_push', { STUB_IGNORED_WORK: '1' }],
    ['local-history', 'checked_push', {}],
    ['clean', 'checked_push', {}]
  ], async ([scenario, expected, extra]) => {
    const label = 'cleanup-' + scenario;
    const source = fixtureSource(label);
    const home = path.join(root, 'deepseek-' + label);
    if (scenario === 'local-history') {
      const privateObjects = path.join(home, 'private objects');
      extra.STUB_LOCAL_TIP = fixtureCommit({ 'local.txt': 'private history\n' }, partial, '', privateObjects);
      extra.STUB_LOCAL_OBJECTS = path.join(privateObjects, 'objects');
    }
    write(path.join(home, 'runner_settings.txt'), 'remove_repo_copy_after_push=yes\n');
    const r = await job('deepseek', label, { ...extra, STUB_RUNNER_TOOLS: deliveryTools,
      PC_TEST_STOP_BEFORE_PUBLISH: '0', WORK_SKIP_CHECKS: '0', PC_TEST_SOURCE: source });
    assert.equal(r.code, 0, r.text + r.result);
    const branch = 'work/issue-687-deepseek' + (scenario === 'partial' ? '-partial' : '');
    const tip = run('git', ['--git-dir', source, 'rev-parse', branch]);
    assert.equal(tip.code, 0, tip.text + r.result);
    assert.equal(read(path.join(r.out, 'confirmed_commit.txt')).trim(), tip.text.trim());
    assert.equal(r.state.status, expected, r.result);
    const publicStatus = JSON.parse(read(r.env.PC_TEST_GH_DB)).comments[0].body;
    const labelShown = expected === 'checked_push' ? 'finished' : expected;
    assert(publicStatus.includes('Runner status: ' + labelShown), publicStatus);
    assert.equal(fs.existsSync(r.repo), scenario !== 'clean', r.result);
    if (scenario === 'ignored-work') {
      assert.equal(read(path.join(r.repo, 'ignored-work.txt')), 'only in the checkout');
      assert(r.result.includes('ignored files'), r.result);
    }
    if (scenario === 'local-history') {
      assert.equal(read(path.join(r.repo, '.git/refs/remotes/origin/stale-local')).trim(), extra.STUB_LOCAL_TIP);
      assert(r.result.includes('local-only history'), r.result);
    }
    assert(fs.existsSync(path.join(r.out, 'result.txt')), 'run evidence stays after cleanup');
    pass('workhorse delivery and cleanup: ' + scenario);
  });
}

+function Get-LegacyRuns($root) {
+  # Runners deployed before R336 recorded the scratch path in status.json but did not name it by issue.
+  foreach ($lane in @('board','board_b','board_c','board_d','work217')) {
+    $base = Join-Path $root $lane
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $base -PathType Container)) { continue }
+    $laneDir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $base -Force
+    Assert-PlainDirectory $laneDir
+    foreach ($job in $laneDir.EnumerateDirectories('issue-*')) {
+      if ($job.Name -notmatch '^issue-([1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?$' -or
+          ($job.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { continue }
+      $issue = $Matches[1]
+      $runs = if ($lane -eq 'work217') {
+        $job.EnumerateDirectories() | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{8}_\d{6}$' -and -not ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) }
+      } else { $job }
+      foreach ($run in $runs) {
+        $out = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'out' } else { $run.FullName }
+        $state = Join-Path $out 'status.json'
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
+        try { $s = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($state) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+        if ($s.scratch.path -notmatch '[\\/]voidsworn-run-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { continue }
+        $repo = if ($lane -eq 'work217') { Join-Path $run.FullName 'repo' } else { Join-Path $base 'repo' }
+        [pscustomobject]@{ Issue = $issue; State = $s; Out = $out; Repo = $repo; Lane = $lane }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Get-ActiveLegacyIssues($runs) {
+  $running = @($runs | Where-Object { $_.State.status -eq 'running' })
+  if (-not $running.Count) { return }
+  try {
+    $commands = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine } | ForEach-Object { $_.CommandLine })
+  } catch {
+    # Keep scratch reported as running when this PC cannot verify the old runner processes.
+    $running.Issue
+    return
+  }
+  foreach ($run in $running) {
+    $paths = @($run.Out, $run.Repo, $run.State.scratch.path) | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }
+    if (@($commands -match (('(?:' + ($paths -join '|') + ')(?=[\\/"\s]|$)'))).Count) { $run.Issue; continue }
+    if ($run.Lane -ne 'work217') {
+      $laneLock = $null
+      try { $laneLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true }
+      catch { $run.Issue }
+      finally { if ($laneLock) { $laneLock.Dispose() } }
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Reserve-AutomaticRun($lock, $trigger, $now, $night) {
+  # Both triggers serialize across lanes. Record admission before cleaning so a killed run cannot be retried in a loop.
+  $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($lock, $utf8, $false, 1024, $true)
+  try { $line = $reader.ReadLine() } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+  $last = 0L; $lastNight = ''
+  if ($line -match '^([0-9]{1,19}) (\d{8})$') { $last = [long]$Matches[1]; $lastNight = $Matches[2] }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly' -and $lastNight -eq $night) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--low-space' -and $last -gt $now.AddHours(-1).Ticks) { return $false }
+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') { $lastNight = $night } else { $last = $now.Ticks }
+  if (-not $lastNight) { $lastNight = '00000000' }
+  $lock.Position = 0
+  $buffer = $utf8.GetBytes("$last $lastNight")
+  $lock.Write($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)
+  $lock.SetLength($buffer.Length)
+  $lock.Flush()
+  return $true
+}
+function Open-JanitorLock($path, $wait) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)
+  while ($true) {
+    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
+    catch [IO.IOException] {
+      if (-not $wait -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf) -or [DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw }
+      Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
+    }
+  }
+}
+function Clear-ScratchFolder($dir, $issue, $why, $hours, $temp, $now, $dryRun, $activeLegacy, $owned) {
+  $size = 'size unavailable'; $issueLock = $null
+  try {
+    $busy = ''
+    if ($issue -and $activeLegacy -contains $issue) { $busy = "issue #$issue has an active older runner" }
+    elseif ($issue) {
+      try { $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue $temp) $dryRun }
+      catch { $busy = "issue #$issue lock is held or could not be verified" }
+    }
+    $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+    if ($dir.FullName -eq $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH) { throw 'current runner scratch' }
+    if ($busy) { throw $busy }
+    if ($owned) {
+      $null = Read-ScratchOwner $dir.FullName
+      $retry = Get-FailedScratchMarker $dir
+      if ($retry -and $retry.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $now.AddDays(-1)) { throw 'newest failed scratch kept for a retry for one day' }
+    }
+    if ($stats.Latest -gt $now.AddHours(-$hours)) { throw "touched in the last $hours hours" }
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    if ($dryRun) { $action = 'would remove' }
+    else { Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir; $action = 'removed' }
+    Log "$action $($dir.FullName) ($size; $why, untouched for at least $hours hours)"
+  } catch { Log "kept $($dir.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  finally { if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() } }
+}

+  exit 2
+}

+try {

+  if ($trigger -eq '--nightly') {

+  if (-not $dryRun) {

+      exit 0

+    catch { Write-Host "janitor lock in use or unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 0 }

+  }

+function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
+  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
+  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
+    throw 'ownership token file changed'
+  }

+  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
+  return $token

+function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
+  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {

+function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
+  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
+  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
+  $pending.Push($directory)
+  while ($pending.Count) {
+    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
+      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
+      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
+      $bytes += $item.Length
+      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
+    }
+  }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
+}
+function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
+  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
+    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
+  }
+  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
+  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
+  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
+}
+function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
+  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
+  $lock = $null
+  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
+  try {
+    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
+      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
+    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
+      $size = 'size unavailable'
+      try {
+        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
+        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
+        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
+        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
+        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
+        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
+        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
+          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
+        }
+        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
+        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
+        else {
+          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
+          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
+        }
+      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
+    }
+  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }
+}

+function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
+  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
+  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
+  try {
+    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
+    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
+    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
+    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
+    try {
+      $stderr = $child.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
+      while ($null -ne ($line = $child.StandardOutput.ReadLine())) { Write-Host $line }
+      $child.WaitForExit()
+      $errors = $stderr.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
+      if ($errors) { [Console]::Error.Write($errors) }
+      return $child.ExitCode
+    }
+    finally { $child.Dispose() }
+  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
+}
